shapeSummary: M3 socket head cap screw with its axis along X. The head is a 5.5 mm diameter, 3 mm long cylinder spanning x=-4.5 to -1.5. The plain 3 mm diameter shank runs 6 mm from x=-1.5 to 4.5. A blind hex socket, 2.5 mm across flats and 1.5 mm deep, is cut into the head's top face. The part sits on Y=0 (Y spans 0 to 5.5) and is centered in Z.
warnings: Socket depth is not stated; 1.5 mm is assumed.
Shank diameter is taken as the nominal 3 mm from the M3 designation; threads are not modeled.
The product text gives length 6 mm, which is the shank only, so overall length is 9 mm including the 3 mm head.
The axis is along X, following the image analysis. Y is 0 to 5.5 so the bottom sits at Y=0, and X is centered on the overall length.
The hex socket orientation is assumed.
The head chamfer is not modeled.
cadquery:
head = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-4.5).center(2.75, 0).circle(2.75).extrude(3)
shank = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-1.5).center(2.75, 0).circle(1.5).extrude(6)
socket = cq.Workplane('YZ').workplane(offset=-4.5).center(2.75, 0).polygon(6, 2.5 / math.cos(math.pi / 6)).extrude(1.5)
part = head.union(shank).cut(socket)
